services.name: Jet Ski Rentals
services.desc: We provide affordability and easy accessibility to rentals from our Kaysville location. Jetski rentals in Bear Lake, UT are offered by a friendly, professional staff that is able to answer all of your jet ski questions and concerns. The best part is that we are located right next to the highway and are en route to all of the area’s lakes. Bear Lake is the perfect destination for riding. Blue Wave Jet Ski Rentals is currently renting the NEW Yamaha VX Sport. Comfortably able to hold 3 riders at a time, our NEW Yamaha VX Sport is the perfect jet ski for fun in the sun. blurb: Blue Wave Jet Ski Rentals offers brand new, well-maintained jet skis and WaveRunners for rent across various lakes in Utah. Their machines fit 2-3 people comfortably and are cleaned thoroughly after each use. Rentals provide high-powered, fast, yet comfortable and safe watercraft for a day of fun on the lake.

quotes.text: Renting from blue wave jet ski rentals was awesome. The pricing was great and the included gas cans made it a breeze to pack the necessary gas for a day on the water. We rented two machines and had a blast on them. We didn’t have any issues with the machines or contacting them when needed. The employees are friendly and extremely helpful. We will definitely rent from them again. Thank you Blue Wave for a great outing with the family!

Blue Wave Jetski Rentals are everything they promised! The equipment they offer is up to date and very clean… I love how they sparkled and shined when the sun hit them!! Besides That, the service was fast, friendly, and very helpful. I will definitely be using these guys again for future events!!!! They are SIMPLY THE BEST!!!

quotes.author: Super friendly staff!
quotes.text: We definitely recommend these guys to anyone that is looking for great customer service, affordable prices on nicely maintained superb running fast machines! They went above and beyond to go over and explain everything and make sure we were comfortable with the contract and fully understood it. Super friendly staff!

quotes.author: Go with them in confidence!
quotes.text: Just want to drop a quick review and let others know what a good experience our family had with Blue Wave Rentals. They obviously know their business and were respectful of my time, which I really appreciate. Go with them in confidence.
